messages.subject_clean: [Mvabund-updates] mvabund v3.6.11 is available on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

Good news: mvabund v3.6.11 is available now on CRAN. This new version is
more stable, faster and does a better fit according to our tests. So please
update your package and try it out!

Best,
Yi Wang
